title: angorkis ramosa
intro: Angorkis ramosa, commonly known as the Climbing Ashoka or Indian Ashoka, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of India and Southeast Asia. It is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Ayurvedic and Unani medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to promote menstrual health, alleviate menstrual cramps, and support the reproductive system. The therapeutic actions of Angorkis ramosa include its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Angorkis ramosa include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
